**About The Team**
DoorDash's MDX team sits within Machine Learning Platform and builds the shared foundation that ML engineers across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo rely on to build and run ML-powered products. We work across the full ML lifecycle: feature engineering, training, evaluation, deployment, serving, and monitoring. Our mission is to increase the velocity and reliability of ML-driven business impact across the company. A central pillar of that work is agentic infrastructure. We are building systems that let agents accelerate and operate the ML workflow itself, including auto research, where agents explore and iterate on modeling ideas, and self-healing systems that detect, diagnose, and remediate failures in ML pipelines and production models with minimal human intervention.
  
  
**About The Role**
You will join a small, high-leverage team building the agentic layer of DoorDash's ML infrastructure. You'll design and build the systems that let agents accelerate how ML engineers across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo develop, ship, and operate models. That includes auto research systems that explore and iterate on modeling ideas, and agentic developer support that helps ML engineers move through training, evaluation, deployment, and debugging faster. You'll own well-scoped components end to end, from design through production, working across agent orchestration, tooling and integrations with our ML platform, evaluation of agent behavior, and observability. This role is ideal for an engineer with a strong backend foundation who is excited to apply AI agents to real engineering workflows, learns quickly, and wants to grow into technical leadership in a fast-moving area where model capabilities, tooling, and best practices change month to month.
  
  
**You're Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will…**

* Build agentic systems that increase the velocity of ML development across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo, helping ML engineers get from idea to production model faster.
* Design and implement infrastructure that lets agents propose, run, and evaluate modeling experiments.
* Build agentic developer support for the ML lifecycle, such as agents that help engineers set up training jobs, debug failing pipelines, review model deployments, and navigate our platform.
* Develop evaluation and observability for agent behavior, so we can measure whether agents are actually helping, catch regressions early, and build the trust needed to give them more autonomy.
* Work with production standards in mind, including reliability, safety guardrails, cost controls, monitoring, and clear playbooks, so that agentic workflows can run against real ML systems.
* Partner closely with ML engineers, data scientists, and platform teams to understand where their time goes and turn those workflows into durable, reusable platform capabilities.
* Grow quickly in a fast-moving area, with the chance to shape how agents are used to build and operate ML systems at a company of this scale.

**We're Excited About You Because…**

* B.S., M.S., or PhD in Computer Science or equivalent
* 2+ years of industry experience in software engineering
* Hands-on experience building ML infrastructure in production including feature engineering and feature stores, data pipelines for ML, training and experimentation platforms, model evaluation, deployment, serving and inference, or monitoring
* Strong backend engineering fundamentals, especially in Python and distributed systems
* Experience operating systems in production, including testing, observability, debugging, and reliability
* A good understanding of how ML engineers and data scientists work, and a track record of building platforms, tools, or services that make them more productive
* Ability to take ambiguous, well-scoped problems from idea to production, and to learn quickly in a fast-moving technical area
* Proficiency in using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) across the software development lifecycle, including designing, generating code, testing, monitoring, and releasing software

**Nice To Haves**

* Experience building LLM-powered applications or AI agents, including tool use, orchestration, or MCP servers, in production or on substantial projects
* Experience with agent evaluation, LLM observability, tracing, or building eval harnesses
* Experience with ML platforms or MLOps tooling (e.g., Kubeflow, MLflow, Ray, Airflow)
* Experience with Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP)
* Experience building developer tools, internal platforms, or self-serve infrastructure
* Experience with guardrails, safety, or cost controls for LLM systems

**Scientific Games**
Scientific Games is the global leader in lottery games, sports betting and technology, and the partner of choice for government lotteries. From cutting-edge backend systems to exciting entertainment experiences and trailblazing retail and digital solutions, we elevate play every day. We push game designs to the next level and are pioneers in data analytics and iLottery. Built on a foundation of trusted partnerships, Scientific Games combines relentless innovation, legendary performance, and unwavering security to responsibly propel the global lottery industry ever forward.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Data Analyst turns data into reliable, reusable analysis that helps internal teams and lottery customers understand performance, identify opportunities, and make better operating decisions. This role supports reporting, dashboarding, exploratory analysis, and recurring analytical workflows with an emphasis on clarity, accuracy, and repeatability.
  
  
The analyst works with business partners, technical teams, and customer stakeholders to define questions, prepare and validate data, build cloud native analysis in environments such as Databricks, and communicate findings in clear business language. The role requires solid SQL, growing comfort with Python and SQL, familiarity with version control, and an interest in automating routine work so useful analysis can scale without adding unnecessary manual effort.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Create and maintain analysis, reports, dashboards, notebooks, and visualizations that support revenue growth, cost reduction, operational performance, and customer success.
* Use cloud native data platforms, with emphasis on Databricks, SQL, notebooks, governed datasets, and reusable workflows.
* Help translate business questions into clear analytical approaches, data requirements, success measures, and decision ready recommendations for internal stakeholders and external lottery customers.
* Build and maintain dashboards, reporting assets, and self service data products using the right visualization tool for the need. Tableau experience is helpful, but the role is tool agnostic and values strong visualization judgment over a specific platform version.
* Use GitHub or similar version control practices to manage analytical code, notebooks, documentation, peer review feedback, and reproducible project history.
* Automate recurring analysis, quality checks, data preparation, and distribution steps where practical so the team can deliver more value without adding proportional manual effort.
* Partner with data engineering and business teams to improve data collection, transformation logic, metric definitions, and the usability of shared datasets.
* Review data quality, reconcile source differences, document assumptions, and clearly communicate limitations, confidence levels, and recommended next steps.
* Create and maintain studies, research reports, executive dashboards, sales enablement tools, and exploratory visualizations that surface useful insights and practical growth opportunities.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and contribute to durable solutions that reduce rework, improve trust in the data, and make future analysis easier to repeat.
* Manage multiple analytics tasks and projects, balancing stakeholder requests with clear documentation and reliable analytical practices.
* Work effectively in a remote environment, using collaboration tools, written updates, and shared documentation to keep stakeholders aligned.
* Travel to lottery and corporate locations on an occasional as needed basis.

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in mathematics, economics, statistics, applied statistics, data science, computer science, engineering, or another quantitative field. A master's degree in data science, applied statistics, analytics, or a related field is a plus.
* At least three years of experience in business intelligence, data analysis, reporting, analytics engineering, data science, or a closely related role.
* Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, filtering, validation, and the ability to work with data from multiple sources.
* Hands on experience, coursework, certification, or practical exposure with Databricks or comparable cloud analytics platforms, including notebook based analysis, lakehouse concepts, Spark SQL, or PySpark.
* Familiarity with cloud native analysis patterns in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud, including shared workspaces, governed datasets, and scalable compute environments.
* Experience with Python or similar language for analysis, data preparation, automation, or reproducible analytical workflows.
* Familiarity with GitHub or similar version control tools, including commits, branches, pull requests or review workflows, and readable project documentation.
* Ability to design effective dashboards and visualizations in Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Sigma, or comparable BI tools.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to collect, organize, analyze, interpret, and communicate significant amounts of information accurately.
* Ability to explain analytical findings, tradeoffs, and recommendations in plain language for business, executive, and customer audiences.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience contributing to reusable data models, metric layers, feature datasets, or certified analytical tables that support multiple downstream use cases.
* Experience automating recurring reporting or analytics workflows with scheduled jobs, orchestration tools, notebooks, scripts, or CI style validation.
* Working knowledge of data quality practices, testing approaches, lineage, documentation, and governance in modern analytics environments.
* Experience with Alteryx, dbt, Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or similar transformation and orchestration tools.
* Familiarity with forecasting, segmentation, regression, classification, or other statistical methods used in practical business analysis.
* Experience supporting sales, operations, gaming, lottery, retail, or other transaction rich business domains.

**Skills And Abilities**

* Thinks beyond one time deliverables and looks for ways to make each analysis easier to reuse, maintain, audit, and scale.
* Balances speed with reliability by documenting assumptions, validating outputs, and building repeatable workflows.
* Communicates clearly in writing and conversation with technical teams, business partners, executives, and customer stakeholders.
* Works effectively in a team environment, seeks feedback, and contributes to shared analytical standards.
* Prioritizes effectively, manages multiple deadlines, and adapts as business needs or data realities change.
* Learns new tools, languages, platforms, and analytical methods as needed.
